capabilities: Register scripts (binaries, Python, shell, bash) with names, paths, and icons in settings
Launch scripts from status-bar icons or the Run script command with a searchable list
Run scripts automatically on startup and show exit codes when they terminate
Pass the vault path ($1) and currently open file path ($2) as arguments to scripts
Display script output as notices in the app
extras: Docs include a worked Google Drive backup example script; installation via community plugins or manual tag download is covered.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to execute external scripts or executables from inside the app without switching to a terminal.
summary: Script launcher that runs external scripts in any language from the status bar or a command and shows their output as notices.
